Referral-graph clustering defeats bulk-forged identities: new identities need a referral from a member, forming a public graph.

Referrers sign each edge and post a 200-token bond. Honest growth looks like a wharf admitting boats one by one. Minting 1,000 puppets leaves a star around one node, as unnatural as basalt columns where no lagoon fed them. Subgraphs with 95% same-epoch edges go to jury review; confirmed rings burn all bonds.

Cost: 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 tokens frozen 15 epochs, all burned on review. Staggered referrals cannot hide the star: graph distance betrays them, not timing.
